name: Sundried Driftwood
summary: Sundried Driftwood lies along the Swamp of Sorrows coast. Watcher Biggs needs strong, dry wood to repair his wagon.

sections.title: Wood from the Coast
sections.body: Watcher Biggs needs timber for a wagon repair, but swamp trees are too spongy and tangled. Along the eastern coast, the sun dries driftwood into light, tough pieces that can serve his need.

faq.q: Where can I find Sundried Driftwood?
faq.answer: Sundried Driftwood can be found on the coast of the Swamp of Sorrows. Watcher Biggs directs you east to search.
Watcher Biggs needs Sundried Driftwood to repair his wagon.

faq.q: Why does Biggs need this wood?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs needs strong, dry wood to repair his wagon so he can reach Nethergarde.

faq.q: Why not use the swamp trees?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs says the swamp's trees are spongy and tangled, so he seeks dry driftwood from the coast.
Watcher Biggs calls the wood light but tough, and says it will work nicely for his wagon.

faq.q: How many pieces does Biggs need?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs asks for eight pieces of Sundried Driftwood.
